access_version.description: Same value as the X-Access-Version header

permissions.description: Every permission key the member has now

at_period_end.description: True keeps access until the period ends; false cancels now

providers.description: Payment providers this server has enabled

gains.description: Permission keys, or a chat access label

plan_price_id.description: A recurring price of another plan or interval

effective_at.description: Now for an upgrade; the period end for a downgrade

provider.description: Omit to use the first provider that sells this price

return_url.description: Where a hosted checkout or 3-D Secure returns to

url.description: Page where the person can check the deletion status

suspended_at.description: A missed installment; free limits apply until it is paid

last_error.description: Why setup failed, when status is failed

completed.description: Setup finished or skipped: open the dashboard

replaces_subscription_id.description: Canceled at checkout; its unused time is credit_minor

order.description: The lifetime deal, with its installments

sensitive.description: Show a warning before giving it

providers.description: Providers that can sell this price

display_name.description: When null, show first_name and last_name

embedded_checkout.description: True: checkout returns a client_secret for an in-app form; false: a url to open

installments.description: The provider can run installment schedules itself

merchant_of_record.description: The provider charges and reports tax

publishable_key.description: Browser key for the provider's embedded form (Stripe Elements)

providers.description: Social sign-in providers this server offers

refresh_token.description: Mobile: refresh token from the last sign-in or refresh

confirm_name.description: The member's name, typed to confirm

copy_from_role_id.description: Start a new role from another role

expected_version.description: The version you edited; 409 if it changed

permissions.description: Omit to keep the current set (or copy_from's)

locked.description: The Owner role can't be edited

reserved.description: Pending invites whose role uses a seat

used.description: Members whose role uses a seat

current.description: True for the device making this request

enabled.description: False: this server can't connect WhatsApp; setup can only skip the step

activated.description: A real customer message has been sent
